content.text: {"comps":[{"label":"C1","good":false,"reason":"In-home personal care and home health for Medicaid and Medicare patients; not education."},{"label":"C2","good":true,"reason":"Online and campus degree and certificate programs for adult learners, tuition-funded, under Title IV oversight; closely matches the target."},{"label":"C3","good":false,"reason":"Professional employer organization and payroll outsourcing for small businesses; not education."},{"label":"C4","good":false,"reason":"Workers' compensation and health claims management for insurers and employers; not education."},{"label":"C5","good":false,"reason":"Outsources enrollment marketing and recruiting to one university; does not itself deliver degrees to students."},{"label":"C6","good":false,"reason":"Management consulting and managed services for hospitals, universities and companies; not a degree provider."},{"label":"C7","good":true,"reason":"Accredited postsecondary schools training students for healthcare careers, tuition-funded, with nursing programs; similar model, though campus-only and regional."},{"label":"C8","good":true,"reason":"Online and campus degree and certificate programs for adult learners paying tuition, under federal aid and accreditation rules; direct peer."},{"label":"C9","good":false,"reason":"Contract engineering, healthcare and IT staffing billed by hour; not education."},{"label":"C10","good":false,"reason":"K-12 virtual public schools funded by districts; serves a different student population and funding model."},{"label":"C11","good":false,"reason":"Commercial and personal insurance brokerage earning carrier commissions; not education."},{"label":"C12","good":false,"reason":"Skilled nursing, senior living and post-acute care reimbursed by Medicare and Medicaid; not education."},{"label":"C13","good":true,"reason":"Tuition-funded career colleges under Title IV rules; offers training in hands-on trades rather than online degrees, a partial product difference."}]}
